column11: JUDGEMENT. No Phase 3 is registered (ClinicalTrials.gov, read 2026-09-28) and Novartis gives first submission as 2029 or later for both indications (Q2 2026 6-K 0001114448-26-000012). Analogue: remibrutinib, Novartis's own immunology medicine. Its dose-finding Phase 2b in chronic spontaneous urticaria (NCT03926611) completed 2021-01-14, its Phase 3 REMIX-1 (NCT05030311) started 2021-11-30, and FDA approved Rhapsido on 2025-09-30 (openFDA NDA218436, original), 56.5 months after the Phase 2b completed. The same 56.5 months from 2028-06-06 is February 2033, so 2034 is the first full year on sale
